variants.name: XM155 'SILENT'
variants.info:
An experimental military cartridge designed to improve suppressor function by reducing the velocity of the round to subsonic levels, thereby eliminating the telltale supersonic crack. The round is also heavier, providing better overall energy retention at range - just watch the drop!

Suppressor masking ranges are significantly better with this round!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: .308 Win.
variants.info:
Load your JG-90 with .308 Winchester.
Giving a familiar 10 round magazine, Your JG-90 now has the benefits of the .308 cartridge which include faster velocities and the ability to kill to the head. Alongside being a whole lot lighter.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
